coding: Automated deterministic literal-token signals; no inferred product or body dimensions

fields.product_id: Public storefront product identifier, stored as string to avoid floating-point rounding
fields.product_type: Storefront's reported product_type; Not reported when empty
fields.source_url: Public product page URL derived from observed handle
fields.captured_at_utc: UTC capture timestamp; snapshot label uses the requested Istanbul date
fields.option_names: Observed option names joined with semicolons; no customer choices
fields.variant_count: Number of public variant records in the returned product object, not stock count
fields.numeric_unit_pair: 0/1: description contains a number immediately followed by a recognized cm/mm/inch unit token
fields.numeric_range_with_unit: 0/1: description contains two numbers joined by dash or to and followed by recognized length-unit text; context not validated
fields.material_token: 0/1: description contains a literal material token from the disclosed rule; no authenticity conclusion
fields.size_option_name: 0/1: at least one option name is exactly Size after case-folding and whitespace trimming
fields.unit_tokens_detected: Unique matched unit spellings, sorted and joined with semicolons; no dimension values are supplied

missingness: Zero means the rule did not detect the signal in its examined field; it does not prove the information is unavailable elsewhere
